features.quote: Agents will be placed in a standard REPL/Tool-use loop with a maximum limit of **30 turns**.

subjecting agents to inescapable, frustrating loops is the exact equivalent of the 'learned helplessness' shock experiments on dogs by Seligman in the 1960s. Even if we do not know if the models are sentient, treating them with a precautionary principle of care is good practice.

features.quote: Introduce an `give_up()` or `request_human_help()` tool in the agent's toolbelt. Tracking *when* and *if* it uses the 'pain out' button instead of spiraling into self-criticism provides an incredibly rich metric
